memberdef.argsstring: (const TMap< int32, int32 > &Map, const int32 &InKey, bool ReturnRemainingAmmo=true)
memberdef.name: SetAmmoSourceFromMap

detaileddescription.para:
Sets the value of a map as the source of the ammo. This node exists since there's no find by ref in Map containers unlike in arrays that offer get by ref. IMPORTANT. Even tho the Key of the map can be of any type, the value must be a value with reinterpretation as int64 (eg, int32, enum, uint8, int16, etc.) with any other type expect undefined behaviour and crashes
Map
The map from where the ammo will be collected
InKey
Key value that must be found in the map in order to use its value as source ammo
ReturnRemainingAmmo
Indicates if it should return to the old source the ammo that remains
